builtin.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one full-body SD game character body-reference still, one person only.
Input image1 is the SOLE art-style, facial rendering, integrated skull/torso/limb proportion and camera reference: the attached blond warrior. Do not use code mannequins. Preserve its compact SD/chibi game illustration proportions, crisp confident outlines, angular matte cel-shaded color planes and readable anime face. Do not turn this into realistic long adult proportions, a capsule/robot mannequin, a baby, or a different art style. Hair spikes do NOT define the skull: infer the existing actual crown inside the hair and keep that crown-to-chin size; do not inflate the bald head to the former hair silhouette.
Change to a completely BALD head with no scalp hair, hair tufts or stubble. Keep natural eyebrows and simple expressive brown eyes. Remove ALL scarf/hood, armor, weapons, gloves, belts, pouches, jewelry, emblems, accessories, socks and shoes.
Dress in a plain OPAQUE BLACK close-fitting short-sleeve crewneck T-SHIRT and plain OPAQUE BLACK fitted short SHORTS ending around upper/mid thigh. Both clothing items are ordinary athletic outer clothing, never underwear, never transparent; abdomen and torso covered. Minimal shallow folds, matte fabric, no logos or thick baggy silhouette. Arms, hands, lower legs and BARE FEET are visible as drawn skin, not gray plastic. No anatomical intimate detail or sexual/muscle exaggeration.
Pose and camera: naturally standing upright supported by BOTH FEET, neutral relaxed expression, arms hanging comfortably with a small gap beside the waist. Both feet point naturally with the body. Entire head, fingertips and toes inside generous safe margins. Same right-facing FRONT THREE-QUARTER about35degrees as reference: front face and both eyes/front torso remain visible, not strict profile or front. Head, torso, pelvis and feet all share this direction. No attack, movement, deep knee bend, T-pose, exaggerated A-pose, hip jut, or hand on hip.
Output requested1024x1536 portrait PNG, truly transparent alpha background, no checkerboard painting, no black rectangle, no floor/ground shadow, no text/numbers/watermark. Even soft neutral light, centered full body at approximately80% canvas height with safe margins. One person, one image, no sheet or couple.

Subject: a young ADULT MALE base body derived from this warrior. Keep his basic face impression, actual skull size and combined SD body ratios. Moderately wider shoulders/upper torso than hips, fairly straight waist, moderately sturdy arms and legs; healthy natural build without exaggerated muscles. Body silhouette must clearly read as masculine even bald, with the same clothing and posture as the female counterpart.
builtin.requestedSize: 1024x1536 in prompt; no builtin size argument
